demo.notes:
· Confirm this week's release scope
· Transcript and minutes within 10 minutes of the meeting
· Report back on the recording tour next time
demo.summary:
This recording runs 42 seconds and covers the transcript and minutes flow.

Agreed in the meeting: transcription appears live while recording, and the notes on the right join the audio when the summary is generated. After stopping, choosing "Summarise" turns the audio, the transcript and the notes into structured minutes.

Follow-up: produce the minutes within ten minutes of the meeting and share them with the team.

Let's walk the whole flow from recording to minutes this time.

Speaker 1　00:00:11
The transcript shows up live on the left; I'll keep the key points in the notes on the right.
